description: Shared fixture for the IfcSpace/IfcZone property resolution twins: ifc_lite_processing::processor::properties (rust/processing/src/processor/properties.rs, exercised by space_zone_property_type_vectors.rs) and the on-demand property extractor (packages/parser/src/columnar-parser.ts + property-value-parser.ts, exercised by packages/parser/src/space-zone-property.parity.test.ts). One IfcSpace (#30) carries two IfcPropertySets: PsetA covers every IfcPropertySingleValue-typed value kind the Rust side special-cases (text/real/integer/boolean/logical), plus an IfcPropertyEnumeratedValue, a $-absent value, and a name/value pair each carrying a STEP encoded-character escape (\S\ and \X2\...\X0\). PsetB re-declares TextProp with a different value to exercise the same-name-in-two-psets shape (commit 9368b2dcd fixed a query-layer collision of this exact shape).
